1 (Currently amended): A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a compliant seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit __having a defined diameter__ without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw.

3 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit __having a diameter of less than 0.030 inches__.

7 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit __having a defined diameter__.

9 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal __selected from the group consisting of polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, and deformable metals__.

10 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the __compliant__ seal.

11 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to __20,000 psi or higher__.
